title: Fix progress table empty on first layout load
description: When a layout is launched for the first time, the agent progress section (cma-table-mode) shows an empty table. The buffer is created by claude-multi--ensure-progress-visible via get-buffer-create, but cma-table-mode is never activated on it and tabulated-list-revert is never called. Only claude-multi/open-progress does both. Fix: ensure-progress-visible (or setup-layout) must activate cma-table-mode and call tabulated-list-revert on the buffer after creating/displaying it.

title: Fix start-agenda to use sonnet model instead of default

title: Add morning layout function
description:
Add claude-multi-layout/morning to autoload/claude-multi-layout.el.

Window arrangement algorithm:
1. delete-other-windows for clean slate
2. Show weekly plan (week-YYYY-Www.org) in main window (left, ~60% width)
3. split-window-right to create right column (~40%)
4. In right column: show jira-triage.org (top)
5. split-window-below at 33% height -> show email-triage.org (middle)
6. split-window-below again -> show task-triage.org (bottom)
7. Disable olivetti-mode in all 3 triage buffers
8. Return focus to weekly plan (left column)
9. Call claude-multi-layout--ensure-progress-visible (pinned bottom side-window)
10. Set claude-multi-layout--current to 'morning

Uses existing helpers: --current-week-file, --ensure-progress-visible, --disable-olivetti-in-buffer.
Uses new helper: --find-or-create-org-file for triage files.

File: autoload/claude-multi-layout.el

title: Add start-morning orchestrator
description:
Add claude-multi-layout/start-morning (interactive, autoloaded) to autoload/claude-multi-layout.el.

The main entry point for SPC c l m:
1. Call claude-multi-layout--ensure-kitty-layout
2. Call claude-multi-layout/morning
3. Spawn triage agent via cma--call 'spawn' with flags: --task '/workview:triage-all' --dir ~/projects/workview --prompt '/workview:triage-all' --json
4. Parse JSON result for agent name and window ID, display confirmation message
5. Handle failure: show error from cma--last-error if spawn fails

Depends on: --prompt flag in Go (claude-multi-agent.el-a7n), morning layout (claude-multi-agent.el-cot), ensure-kitty-layout (claude-multi-agent.el-svu)
